title: I Live With Roaches
blurb: Delivered with such flat, matter-of-fact calm that it stops being a complaint and becomes a philosophy. There is no shame in the voice at all. The situation is simply reported, the way you might report the weather, and the internet took it up for admitting any unglamorous truth about your flat, your finances or your standards. Honesty this bleak eventually loops back around into comedy. Play it when somebody asks how things are going and you have decided, just this once, to answer them accurately.
